Record Class TypefaceSelection

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.api.TypefaceSelection
Record Components:
family - namespaced resource-pack family, or VANILLA_ID
mode - renderer choice, including the family default
scale - multiplier applied to the family's logical em size
smallPixels - Auto transition in framebuffer pixels per em, or zero to use the family default
missingGlyph - what to do when none of the declared faces covers a cluster
public record TypefaceSelection(net.minecraft.util.ResourceLocation family, TypefaceSelection.Mode mode, float scale, int smallPixels, TypefaceSelection.MissingGlyph missingGlyph) extends Record
Chooses how a client draws a typeface. A selection can be stored or constructed on either side of the game; creating one never opens a font or touches graphics state.

    • TypefaceSelection

      public TypefaceSelection(net.minecraft.util.ResourceLocation family, TypefaceSelection.Mode mode, float scale, int smallPixels, TypefaceSelection.MissingGlyph missingGlyph)
      Validates a selection without looking up client resources.
      Parameters:
      family - namespaced family
      mode - renderer choice
      scale - logical size multiplier, from 0.5 through 2
      smallPixels - zero or a transition from 8 through 48 pixels
      missingGlyph - missing cluster policy
